About

A little about me

I am Muthuraj, a UI/UX-focused Frontend Developer with 1 year of professional experience at Genpact. I completed my UI/UX course and developed a strong interest in creating digital interfaces that are both visually appealing and easy to use.

My design background helps me understand user requirements, information hierarchy, wireframing, prototyping and visual design. My frontend interest allows me to take those designs further and transform them into responsive web interfaces.

Currently, I am looking for opportunities where I can grow as a Frontend Developer while applying my UI/UX knowledge to build better digital products.

View Live Pages →

Project Overview

Annam Hotel is a traditional food delivery website concept designed to combine the visual identity of traditional South Indian food with a clean and modern digital experience.

Problem

Traditional restaurants often have strong food identities but their digital experiences can feel outdated, cluttered or difficult to navigate. The goal was to design a modern interface that preserves the traditional identity while making food discovery and ordering simple.

Goal

  • Highlight traditional food
  • Make navigation simple
  • Clearly present food items
  • Create trust in the restaurant
  • Enjoyable browsing experience
  • Work across desktop and mobile

My Role

  • UI/UX Design
  • User Flow
  • Wireframing
  • Visual Design
  • Prototyping
  • Responsive Layout
  • Frontend Implementation

UI/UX Process

How I approach design

I don't see design and development as separate processes — my goal is to understand both sides and build interfaces where visual design, usability and frontend implementation work together.

01

Understand

02

03

04

05

06

08
